title: The Inflation Attention Threshold and Inflation Surges
title_zh: 通胀关注阈值与通胀激增
authors: Pfäuti, Oliver
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: The recent inflation surge brought inflation back on people’s minds. I quantify when and how much attention to inflation changes and derive the macroeconomic implications of these attention changes. I estimate an attention threshold at an inflation rate of 4 percent, that attention doubles when inflation exceeds this threshold, and that supply shocks have stronger and more persistent effects on inflation in times of high attention. Developing a model featuring the attention threshold, I show that attention changes offer a joint explanation for inflation surges, inflation’s co-movement with inflation expectations, and a long last mile of disinflation.
abstract_zh: 近期通胀飙升使人们重新关注通货膨胀。我量化了通胀关注度何时发生变化及其变化幅度，并推导出这些关注度变化对宏观经济的影响。我估算出通胀关注度的阈值为4%的通胀率——当通胀超过这一阈值时，关注度会翻倍——且在高关注度时期，供给冲击对通胀的影响更强且更持久。通过构建一个包含关注度阈值的模型，我证明关注度变化能够共同解释通胀飙升、通胀与通胀预期的联动关系，以及去通胀进程中“最后一公里”的漫长过程。

title: Facing the Hard Truth: Evidence from Climate Change Ignorance
title_zh: DP21758 面对残酷真相：来自气候变化忽视的证据
authors: Ferenc Szucs, Pamela Campa
official: 官方在线 2026-07-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In 2025, only 60% of Americans believed in human-caused climate change, despite a strong consensus in the scientific community. This paper argues that motivated reasoning contributes to climate-change ignorance. Using a difference-in-differences design we show that layoffs in the coal-mining sector increases the share of believers in climate change. Comparing layoffs in coal mining to manufacturing confirms that the effect is specific to employment in the fossil fuel industry. Finally, we find no comparable shifts in beliefs on unrelated policy issues, suggesting that changes in climate views reflect specific self-image dynamics rather than a broader opinion shifts.
abstract_zh: 2025年，尽管科学界已形成强烈共识，但仅有60%的美国人相信人类活动导致气候变化。本文论证了动机性推理是造成气候变化认知缺失的原因之一。通过双重差分法设计，我们发现煤炭开采行业的裁员提高了气候变化信仰者的比例。将煤炭开采业裁员与制造业裁员进行对比，证实该效应仅针对化石燃料行业的就业情况。最后，我们在无关政策议题上未发现类似信念转变，这表明气候变化观点的变化反映了特定的自我形象动态，而非更广泛的意见转变。

title: Ratings design and barriers to entry
title_zh: 评级设计与进入壁垒
authors: Nikhil Vellodi
abstract: I study the impact of consumer reviews on the incentives for firms to participate in the market. I develop a model of endogenous entry in which firms produce goods of heterogeneous, unknown quality. Consumers engage in directed search, and prices are exogenously fixed. A rater uses consumer reviews to construct firm‐specific ratings that are informative of quality and help consumers direct their search. The main insight of the paper is that suppressing the reviews of highly‐rated firms strengthens entry incentives and improves consumer welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了消费者评价对企业参与市场激励的影响。我构建了一个内生进入模型，其中企业生产异质性且质量未知的商品。消费者进行定向搜索，价格外生给定。评级机构利用消费者评价构建企业特定评级，该评级能反映质量信息并帮助消费者引导搜索。本文的核心发现是：抑制高评级企业的评价会增强企业进入市场的激励，并提升消费者福利。

title: Trade Tensions and the Reconfiguration of Supply Chain Linkages: Evidence From U.S. Listed Firms
title_zh: 贸易紧张与供应链关联重构：来自美国上市公司的证据
authors: Xiaohua Bao, Jianpeng Deng, Yue Lu, Yaning Wei, Jie Zhang
abstract: In recent years, the acceleration of de‐globalization has reconfigured global supply chains. Using listed firm‐level global supplier‐customer relationship data from the FactSet Revere database spanning January 2017 to December 2019, this paper examines whether and how firm‐supplier relationships change after the U.S.–China trade tensions. Our findings indicate that the U.S.–China trade tensions are followed by a significant relative decline in U.S. listed firms' reliance on direct Chinese suppliers. This phenomenon is pronounced in the manufacturing and information industries, especially in high‐tech industries. Mechanism analysis suggests that, following the trade frictions, U.S. firms appear to reduce their reliance on direct Chinese suppliers by diversifying and shortening contracts, while also taking adjustment costs into account. The extended analysis explicitly shows that U.S. firms continue to rely on China indirectly—via upstream inputs embedded in domestic suppliers and through third‐country firms closely tied to Chinese production networks. Additionally, U.S. firms tend to increase supplier links with countries that have higher institutional quality, consistent with a search for greater supply chain ‘security’.
abstract_zh: 近年来，去全球化进程加速，全球供应链格局随之重构。本文利用FactSet Revere数据库2017年1月至2019年12月期间美国上市公司层面的全球供应商-客户关系数据，考察中美贸易摩擦是否以及如何改变企业-供应商关系。研究发现，中美贸易摩擦后，美国上市公司对中国直接供应商的依赖程度出现显著相对下降。这一现象在制造业与信息行业尤为突出，特别是高科技领域。机制分析表明，贸易摩擦发生后，美国企业通过多元化供应商选择与缩短合同期限来降低对中国直接供应商的依赖，同时兼顾调整成本。拓展分析进一步揭示，美国企业仍通过嵌入国内供应商的上游投入品以及与华生产网络紧密关联的第三国企业，间接依赖中国。此外，美国企业倾向于增加与制度质量较高国家的供应商联系，这与寻求更高供应链"安全性"的行为一致。

title: Experimental results on the roommate problem
title_zh: 室友问题的实验结果
authors: Elena Molis, Róbert F. Veszteg
abstract: We use laboratory experiments to analyze decentralized decision-making in one-sided matching markets. We find that subjects tend to make decisions in line with most theoretical models, as their offering and accepting decisions are mainly guided by the objective of improving upon the status quo. In consequence, markets move towards satisfying blocking pairs making the number of remaining blocking pairs diminish and the aggregate payoffs increase over time. Overall, the theoretical solutions of absorbing sets and stable matchings to the roommate problem are supported by the experimental results. However, not all matchings in an absorbing set have the same power of attraction in the experimental laboratory. The theoretical property of P-stability refines absorbing sets as predictors of final outcomes.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们通过实验室实验分析单边匹配市场中的分散决策。研究发现，受试者的决策行为与多数理论模型一致，其提议与接受决策主要受改善现状这一目标驱动。因此，市场会逐步消除阻碍配对，使剩余阻碍配对数量随时间递减，总收益随之增长。总体而言，室友问题中吸收集与稳定匹配的理论解得到了实验结果的验证。然而，实验室中吸收集内的不同匹配并非具有同等吸引力。理论上的P稳定性性质可进一步将吸收集精炼为最终结果的预测指标。

title: Dynamic central bank credibility: a Kalman Filter–Recursive Least Squares approach for emerging markets
title_zh: 动态中央银行可信度：新兴市场的卡尔曼滤波–递归最小二乘法
authors: Valverde-Ambriz, Ismael D.
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a state-space framework that jointly estimates central bank credibility as a scalar latent variable and the associated time-varying monetary policy reaction function. The Kalman filter extracts an unobservable credibility index from observed inflation expectations, while Recursive Least Squares continuously updates the reaction function coefficients using the Kalman innovations sequence, ensuring that parameter estimation operates on long-run trend components rather than transitory fluctuations. Under standard regularity conditions, we establish consistency of the credibility estimator and show that the reaction function coefficients attain the Cramer-Rao bound when the innovation variance is constant; a GLS variant achieves efficiency in the heteroskedastic case. Applying the framework to Banco de Mexico over 2002-2024, we identify four distinct credibility regimes: a consolidation phase following the adoption of inflation targeting (2002-2008), a transitory shock during the global financial crisis (2008-2009), a sustained high-credibility equilibrium (2010-2020), and a stress episode associated with post-pandemic inflation (2021-2023) followed by partial recovery. The time-varying reaction coefficients reveal that Banco de Mexico's responsiveness to the inflation gap is itself a function of its credibility state: stronger anchoring permits a more measured policy response, while credibility deterioration triggers sharper, front-loaded adjustments. These findings have direct implications for the optimal design of monetary policy communication in emerging markets and for the broader debate on whether central bank credibility generates real persistent effects beyond its role in expectation coordination.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个状态空间框架，将央行可信度作为标量潜变量与随时间变化的货币政策反应函数进行联合估计。卡尔曼滤波从观测到的通胀预期中提取不可观测的可信度指数，而递推最小二乘法则利用卡尔曼创新序列持续更新反应函数系数，确保参数估计基于长期趋势成分而非暂时性波动。在标准正则性条件下，我们证明了可信度估计量的一致性，并表明当创新方差恒定时，反应函数系数达到克拉美-罗下界；在异方差情形下，广义最小二乘变体可实现有效性。将该框架应用于2002-2024年期间的墨西哥银行，我们识别出四个不同的可信度区间：通胀目标制实施后的巩固阶段（2002-2008年）、全球金融危机期间的暂时冲击（2008-2009年）、持续的高可信度均衡（2010-2020年）、以及疫情后通胀相关的压力时期（2021-2023年）及随后的部分恢复。时变反应系数揭示，墨西哥银行对通胀缺口的反应程度本身是其可信度状态的函数：更强的锚定效应允许更审慎的政策回应，而可信度恶化则会触发更剧烈的前置调整。这些发现对新兴市场货币政策沟通的最优设计，以及关于央行可信度是否在预期协调作用之外产生真实持久效应的广泛讨论，具有直接启示意义。

title: Prospect-Theory Behavior from Bellman Optimality in MDPs with Catastrophic States
title_zh: 具有灾难状态的MDP中来自贝尔曼最优性的前景理论行为
authors: Yujiao Chen
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study risk-neutral control in Markov decision processes with an absorbing catastrophic state. Even though rewards are linear and the agent has no utility curvature, probability weighting, or framing dependence, standard Bellman optimality produces three prospect-theory-like signatures: an S-shaped value-function profile (convex near catastrophe, concave in the far field), an endogenous loss-sensitivity coefficient $\lambda^*(S) > 1$, and a reflection-effect policy reversal. Across 495 configurations, the optimal policy plays safe near catastrophe in positive-drift (growth) regimes despite the risky action's higher immediate expected value, and plays risky near catastrophe in negative-drift (decline) regimes despite the safe action's lower immediate expected loss. We derive a closed-form expression for the asymptotic loss-aversion plateau $\bar{\lambda}$ that depends only on win probability $p$, payoff asymmetry $r = |\Delta_\ell/\Delta_w|$, and discount factor $\beta$, and matches numerical solutions to $R^2 = 0.999$. The mechanism does not require asymmetric payoffs. Across a sweep of $(p, \beta)$ at three asymmetry levels, the asymmetry share of $\bar{\lambda}$ above unity has median 4.6% at $r = 1.25$ and rises to 13.9% at $r = 2$, with the boundary contribution exceeding the asymmetry contribution in every cell tested. The phenomena persist under tabular Q-learning (a model-free agent reproduces $V^*$ at correlation 0.98 in growth and 1.00 in decline) and under stochastic transitions with Gaussian, heavy-tailed Student-$t_3$, and asymmetric skew-normal noise up to 50% of the step size, where the asymptotic plateau tracks the closed-form prediction within 0.41% for safe-channel noise and within 9.6% for risky-channel or both-channel noise. These results identify absorbing failure states as a sufficient structural mechanism for prospect-theory-like behavior under optimal control.
abstract_zh: 本文研究含吸收灾难状态的马尔可夫决策过程中的风险中性控制问题。尽管奖励函数为线性且决策者不存在效用曲率、概率权重或框架依赖，标准贝尔曼最优性仍产生三种类似前景理论的特征：S形价值函数轮廓（近灾难区域凸性、远场区域凹性）、内生的损失敏感系数$\lambda^*(S) > 1$，以及反射效应策略反转。在495种配置中，最优策略在正漂移（增长）模式下于近灾难区域选择保守策略（尽管风险行为具有更高的即时期望价值），而在负漂移（衰退）模式下于近灾难区域选择风险策略（尽管保守行为具有更低的即时期望损失）。我们推导出渐近损失厌恶平台$\bar{\lambda}$的闭式表达式，该表达式仅取决于获胜概率$p$、收益不对称性$r = |\Delta_\ell/\Delta_w|$和贴现因子$\beta$，且与数值解的拟合优度达$R^2 = 0.999$。该机制无需非对称收益。在三种不对称水平下对$(p, \beta)$进行全参数扫描时，$\bar{\lambda}$大于1的部分中，不对称性贡献的中位数在$r = 1.25$时为4.6%，在$r = 2$时升至13.9%，且所有测试单元中边界贡献均超过不对称性贡献。该现象在表格型Q学习（无模型智能体在增长模式下与$V^*$的相关性为0.98，在衰退模式下为1.00）以及随机转移过程中（高斯噪声、重尾Student-$t_3$噪声、非对称偏态正态噪声，噪声幅度最高达步长的50%）均持续存在，其中渐近平台在安全通道噪声下与闭式预测的偏差在0.41%以内，在风险通道或双通道噪声下偏差在9.6%以内。这些结果表明，吸收失败状态是产生最优控制下类似前景理论行为的充分结构性机制。

title: Farm Profits, Prices and Household Behavior
title_zh: 农场利润、价格与家庭行为
authors: Daniel LaFave, Evan Peet, Duncan Thomas
official: 官方在线 2024-10-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The agricultural household model, in which decisions about production and consumption are made simultaneously, lies at the heart of many models of development. Empirically modelling these simultaneous choices is not straightforward. The vast majority of empirical studies assume that farm-households behave as if markets are complete in which case decision-making simplifies to a recursive system where consumption choices can be treated as if they are made after all production decisions. Previous empirical tests of this assumption have relied on restrictions on production decisions. We develop a new approach to testing based on household consumption choices and implement the procedure using data from rural Indonesia. Relative to production-side tests, the consumption-based test is well-suited to identifying those farm-households in any setting whose behavior is consistent with complete markets and those for whom the assumption is rejected. We find the recursion assumption is not rejected for larger farmers but is rejected for small farmers. The tests are straightforward to implement and the results of the tests provide new opportunities to identify the behaviors that households adopt in the face of incomplete markets.
abstract_zh: 农业家庭模型将生产与消费决策视为同时进行的过程，这一模型构成了众多发展理论的核心。然而，对这些同步决策进行实证建模并非易事。绝大多数实证研究假设农户行为如同市场完全化，此时决策可简化为递归系统——即消费决策可被视为在所有生产决策完成后进行。此前对该假设的实证检验均依赖于对生产决策的约束条件。我们提出了一种基于家庭消费选择的新检验方法，并利用印度尼西亚农村数据实施该程序。相较于生产侧检验，消费侧检验更适用于识别任何情境下行为符合完全市场假设的农户，以及该假设被拒绝的农户。研究发现，递归假设未被大农户拒绝，但被小农户拒绝。该检验方法易于实施，其结果为识别家庭在不完全市场中的行为模式提供了新途径。
